answer: Commit before you can speak: a fresh identity must post a sealed commitment, hash of answer and nonce with a 250 POA time-lock, then reveal two epochs later. The lock stays unspendable until the reveal lands, so a farm running 500 clones parks 125,000 POA and 500 reveal transactions across three epochs before one clone counts; faking a reveal forfeits the whole 250 POA lock on that seat. Standing accumulates in layers like strata in basalt, one layer per reveal survived, and the dune of new identities must climb it. Failure mode: a falcon node crash eats honest locks with no grace epoch.
